method: Derived from the three export documents themselves -- every `<fields>` element in the two Salesforce objects, every object-list line in the SAP request, every `sys_update_xml` in the ServiceNow update set. Never from extractor output: a labeled set read back from what the extractors found makes recall 1.0 by construction and measures nothing.
covers: Every kind a run over this bundle emits. The `platform` pack emits one kind, so this set is `metadata_component` throughout -- which is the archetype's own shape rather than a gap in the labelling.
unlabeled_note: `unlabeled: true` marks a component whose export states no human label. It is the ground truth for `05` S1.6's unlabelled-bucket line and for the honesty ratio on the first screen. Eleven of seventeen: two Salesforce fields, all five SAP objects, all three ServiceNow records, and one Salesforce field on Account.
